title: Resolution urging Albany to fund youth sports from betting revenue
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation setting aside a portion of state sports betting revenue to support youth sports programs, upgrade community sports infrastructure and expand access to recreational athletics statewide. It cites that New York earned $184.5 million from sports betting in February 2025 alone, with revenue projected to surpass $1 billion in 2025, compared to just $15 million in state youth sports funding in 2024.
